question: Is Yaxel Lendeborg (GS, rookie, undrafted in our league) worth picking up? Our 13 active slots are full, so 'Yes' means adding him and dropping one of our active players; name the drop in your rationale.
taken: # Players already off the board, one per line. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# Full draft: see council/draft_results.csv for all 104 picks.

ballots.rationale: Drop Caleb Wilson. This replaces this morning's Wiggins-for-Wilson as the first move. If a second add is allowed, also do Wiggins for Ware, which was my morning vote. Neither rookie has an NBA game, so preseason is the only measured evidence. Scored with league_scoring, Lendeborg is 44.25 FP/g (65.7 per 36, about 41 if I estimate the unreported turnovers) against Wilson's 22.4 (30.3 per 36, 17 TO), and both play forward, so the G count doesn't change. Lendeborg's ESPN ownership is 51.81% and rising, and his first starter's line on 21 Oct gets him claimed, while Wiggins at 71% and flat is the player more likely to still be there next week.
